meta.title: GETI Info — Overwatch listings
meta.description: Overwatch recruitment posts from the GETI network, gathered and filterable: players, teams, subs, staff, scrims and casts.
meta.shareDescription: Find an Overwatch player, team, scrim or cast among the posts of the GETI network.

hero.lede: Posts published on the Discord servers of the GETI network, relayed here and sorted for you. Filter, spot what fits, copy the Discord username and contact the author.
hero.retention: {days, plural, one {Posts are kept # day} other {Posts are kept # days}} after they are published, then erased. A post edited or deleted on Discord is edited or deleted here too.

lfp.title: Looking for a player
lfp.lede: Teams that are recruiting: spot the ones looking for your role and rank.

lft.title: Looking for a team
lft.lede: Players looking for a team: filter by role, rank and availability.

lfsub.title: Looking for a sub
lfsub.lede: Teams missing someone for a match or a scrim, often for the same evening.

lfstaff.title: Looking for staff
lfstaff.lede: Coaches, managers, analysts: teams looking for them and people offering their help.

lfs.title: Looking for a scrim
lfs.lede: Teams looking for a practice match: filter by level, day and time.

lfcast.title: Looking for a cast
lfcast.lede: Organisers looking for casters, and casters who are available.

official.line: These posts come from the GETI network. Join its server to publish yours on every subscribed server.

publish.title: Publish a post
publish.intro: Posts on this page are not written on the site: they come from Discord.
publish.stepChannel: Write your post in this category's channel, on our Discord server. It shows up here within moments.
publish.stepGeti: To reach the whole network, publish it from the official GETI server too: it is the one relaying posts to subscribed servers.
publish.rules: A post edited or deleted on Discord is edited or deleted on this page too.

filters.title: Filters
filters.apply: {count, plural, =0 {No posts: close the filters} one {Show the post} other {Show all # posts}}
filters.ranksHint: Keeps posts whose rank range overlaps yours. A legacy SR (“3500”, “4k”) is converted to a rank.
filters.rolesHint: A “Flex” post accepts every role: it stays visible whatever role you pick.
filters.levelsHint: The FACEIT league divisions, from the most accessible (Open) to the toughest (Expert).
filters.timeHint: Keeps posts with a time inside this slot; “22:00 → 02:00” crosses midnight. Hours are the ones written in the post, most often Paris time.
filters.ageAll: All ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
filters.ageDays: {days, plural, one {Less than 24 h} other {Less than # days}}
filters.showClosedHint: A post fully struck through by its author is considered closed: the spot is taken.
filters.includeUnknown: Include posts that leave a criterion unspecified
filters.includeUnknownHint: Many posts give neither region nor platform. Untick to keep only those stating every criterion you picked.

results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No posts} one {# post} other {# posts}}
results.countFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {No post matches} one {# post matches} other {# posts match}}
results.empty: No posts in this category for now.
results.beyond: This page no longer exists: the list has become shorter.

post.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the username by hand.
